# sendio_domain (Resource)

A sending domain. Creating it returns the DNS records to publish; use `sendio_domain_verification` to check them and wait until the domain is verified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_domain" "mail" {
  name               = "mail.example.com"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  open_tracking      = true
  click_tracking     = true
  tracking_subdomain = "links"
}

# Publish the records with your DNS provider, for example:
output "dns_records" {
  value = sendio_domain.mail.records
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Domain name, lower case (for example `mail.example.com`). Changing it creates a new domain.

### Optional

- `click_tracking` (Boolean) Track link clicks in mail sent from this domain.
- `custom_return_path` (String) Return-Path subdomain label (default `send`). Changing it creates a new domain.
- `open_tracking` (Boolean) Track opens of mail sent from this domain.
- `region` (String) Sending region: `us-east-1` (default), `eu-west-1`, `sa-east-1` or `ap-northeast-1`. Changing it creates a new domain.
- `tracking_subdomain` (String) Subdomain label for tracked links (for example `links`). It can be changed in place, but the API cannot remove it, so removing it from the configuration replaces the domain.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the domain was added.
- `id` (String) Domain id.
- `records` (Attributes List) DNS records to publish for the domain, with their verification status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--records))
- `status` (String) Verification status: `not_started`, `pending`, `partially_verified`, `verified`, `failed`, ...
- `tracking_status` (String) Status of the tracking host (`off`, `pending`, `active`, ...).

<a id="nestedatt--records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Record name, relative to the domain.
- `priority` (Number) MX priority.
- `record` (String) What the record is for: `SPF`, `DKIM`, `Tracking`, `Receiving MX`, ...
- `status` (String) Verification status of this record.
- `ttl` (String) Suggested TTL (`Auto` when any TTL works).
- `type` (String) DNS record type (`MX`, `TXT`, `CNAME`, `CAA`).
- `value` (String) Record value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By id or by name
terraform import sendio_domain.mail 4ef0f1a6-2c0b-4d0e-8f0e-2b1d6a1f0c11
terraform import sendio_domain.mail mail.example.com
```
